decision: The five approved replacements complete the ten-case human-language calibration. No further language tuning is authorized from this cohort.

original_input.plain_insight: Before a meeting ends, you may leave the next step unclear instead of saying who will take it.
original_input.plain_action: Before the meeting ends, say who will take the next step.

calibrated_input.plain_insight: Before a meeting ends, you may leave the next step unclear instead of saying who will take it.
calibrated_input.plain_action: Before the meeting ends, say who will take the next step.

supporting_evidence.claim: names who owns the next handoff before you withdraw under pressure
Clarify one owner and use creativity as the visible standard.

excluded_unsupported_phrases: because you doubt your own direction

original_input.plain_insight: When someone makes you a promise, you may wait for a clear sign that it will actually happen.
original_input.plain_action: Ask when the plan will happen.

calibrated_input.plain_insight: When someone makes you a promise, you may wait for a clear sign that it will actually happen.
calibrated_input.plain_action: Ask when the plan will happen.

supporting_evidence.claim: asks what a warm promise will look like in follow-through
Answer the practical promise and make one follow-through detail observable without abandoning thoughtful.

original_input.plain_insight: You may move something in a shared room before everyone has talked through the change.

calibrated_input.plain_insight: You may move something in a shared room before everyone has talked through the change.

supporting_evidence.claim: changes the placement of one object before debating the whole household

original_input.plain_insight: You notice when one person keeps ending up with a group role nobody clearly gave them.
original_input.plain_action: If the group needs someone in that role, ask them directly.

calibrated_input.plain_insight: You notice when the same person keeps ending up responsible for something nobody actually asked them to do.
calibrated_input.plain_action: If the group needs someone to do it, ask them directly.

supporting_evidence.claim: notices who keeps receiving the group role nobody named
Invite one person clearly and make the invitation specific to the energetic dynamic.

excluded_unsupported_phrases: because you need to manage the group

original_input.plain_insight: When you consider a purchase, you compare the comfort it gives you now with what else you could use the money for.
original_input.plain_action: Think of one other thing you could use the money for before you decide.

calibrated_input.plain_insight: When you consider a purchase, you compare the comfort it gives you now with what else you could use the money for.
calibrated_input.plain_action: Think of one other thing you could use the money for before you decide.

supporting_evidence.claim: compares the relief of a purchase with the option it removes
Price immediate comfort against the future option the purchase would remove from a loyalty choice.

excluded_unsupported_phrases: even when you can afford it
because you are afraid to spend

original_input.plain_insight: You may finish one task and then look for another instead of using the time to rest.
original_input.plain_action: After a task, put your phone away and leave the next one for later.

calibrated_input.plain_insight: You may finish one task and then look for another instead of using the time to rest.
calibrated_input.plain_action: After a task, put your phone away and leave the next one for later.

supporting_evidence.claim: ends one maintenance loop before checking for another
puts the phone away when you refuse to shift as needed

excluded_unsupported_phrases: because you need to feel useful

original_input.plain_insight: After someone gives you credit, you may keep going instead of letting the finished work stand.
original_input.plain_action: Say what you did, then let the finished work stand.

calibrated_input.plain_insight: After someone gives you credit for something you did, you may keep working on it instead of accepting that it is finished.
calibrated_input.plain_action: Take credit for what you did, then let yourself be done with it.

supporting_evidence.claim: states the contribution without reducing it to luck
lets the finished result stand before you treat vulnerability like a loss of position

excluded_unsupported_phrases: because you are uncomfortable with praise

original_input.plain_insight: A repeated step in your routine may keep making things harder after it stops helping.
original_input.plain_action: Change the step that keeps making the routine harder.

calibrated_input.plain_insight: You may keep doing something the same way out of habit, even when it starts creating more work for you.
calibrated_input.plain_action: Change the part of your routine that is making things harder instead of easier.

supporting_evidence.claim: marks the repeated step that creates the most rework
Alter one repeated step and watch what becomes easier for this clarity rhythm.

original_input.plain_insight: When you disagree with someone, name what happened before deciding why they did it.
original_input.plain_action: Say what happened before you guess why it happened.

calibrated_input.plain_insight: When you disagree with someone, you may decide why they did something before you know what actually happened.
calibrated_input.plain_action: Start with what you know happened before deciding what they meant by it.

supporting_evidence.claim: separates the observable impact from the motive being assumed
Separate impact from motive, then state one repair condition that addresses impulsive.

excluded_unsupported_phrases: because they wanted to hurt you

original_input.plain_insight: You can learn more about a new opportunity before deciding whether to leave what already works.
original_input.plain_action: Take one small step that lets you learn more before you decide.

calibrated_input.plain_insight: When a new opportunity comes up, you may try it in a small way before giving up something that already works for you.
calibrated_input.plain_action: Take one small step toward the new opportunity before making a bigger decision.

supporting_evidence.claim: builds a reversible test before you give too much
Test the opening with the smallest step that produces useful proof about warmth.

excluded_unsupported_phrases: because you are afraid of risk
